suggestions.label: Docker Compose shortcuts
suggestions.description: Short aliases for the Docker Compose commands you type most: bring the stack up in the background, tear it down, and tail its logs.
suggestions.snippet:
alias dcu="docker compose up -d"
alias dcd="docker compose down"
alias dcl="docker compose logs -f"

suggestions.label: Navigation shortcuts
suggestions.description: Quick directory listing and "go up N levels" aliases so you don't have to type `cd ..` repeatedly.

suggestions.label: Homebrew shell environment (Apple Silicon)
suggestions.description: Puts Homebrew's /opt/homebrew binaries on your PATH. Needed on Apple Silicon Macs if brew-installed tools aren't found in new shells.

suggestions.label: Shared, deduplicated history
suggestions.description: Makes shell history bigger, shares it live across open terminal tabs, and drops immediate duplicate entries so repeated commands don't clutter it.
suggestions.snippet:
HISTSIZE=10000
SAVEHIST=10000
setopt SHARE_HISTORY
setopt HIST_IGNORE_DUPS

suggestions.label: Case-insensitive tab completion
suggestions.description: Lets tab-completion match regardless of case, so `cd doc<TAB>` still finds `Documents`.

suggestions.label: Better directory jumping
suggestions.description: Enables zsh's built-in directory stack shortcuts: `cd -3` jumps to the 3rd previously visited directory, and `dirs -v` lists them.
suggestions.snippet:
setopt AUTO_PUSHD
setopt PUSHD_IGNORE_DUPS
alias dirs="dirs -v"

suggestions.label: Correct minor typos in commands
suggestions.description: Asks "did you mean..." when a command is almost right (e.g. `sudo mkae` instead of `sudo make`), instead of just failing.

suggestions.label: Homebrew shell environment (Apple Silicon)
suggestions.description: Puts Homebrew's /opt/homebrew binaries on your PATH for login shells. Needed on Apple Silicon Macs if brew-installed tools aren't found.

suggestions.label: Add ~/bin to PATH
suggestions.description: Makes your personal scripts folder (~/bin) runnable by name from anywhere, without a full path.

suggestions.label: Set default editor
suggestions.description: Tells git, crontab, and other CLI tools which editor to open for commit messages and similar prompts.

suggestions.label: Navigation shortcuts
suggestions.description: Quick directory listing and "go up N levels" aliases so you don't have to type `cd ..` repeatedly.

suggestions.label: Larger, deduplicated history
suggestions.description: Keeps far more history than Bash's small default, avoids storing immediate repeats, and appends to the history file instead of overwriting it when multiple shells are open.

suggestions.label: Case-insensitive tab completion
suggestions.description: Lets tab-completion match regardless of case, so `cd doc<TAB>` still finds `Documents`.

suggestions.label: Check window size after every command
suggestions.description: Fixes wrapped/garbled output after resizing your terminal window by re-reading its size before drawing the next prompt.

suggestions.label: Source .bashrc from login shells
suggestions.description: macOS Terminal opens login shells, which don't read .bashrc automatically — this line makes sure your aliases and settings from .bashrc still apply.

suggestions.label: Add ~/bin to PATH
suggestions.description: Makes your personal scripts folder (~/bin) runnable by name from anywhere, without a full path.

suggestions.label: Add ~/bin to PATH
suggestions.description: Makes your personal scripts folder (~/bin) runnable by name from anywhere, without a full path.

suggestions.label: Set default editor
suggestions.description: Tells git, crontab, and other CLI tools which editor to open for commit messages and similar prompts.

suggestions.label: Common aliases
suggestions.description: Familiar Unix-style names for everyday PowerShell cmdlets, handy if you switch between shells a lot.
suggestions.snippet:
Set-Alias ll Get-ChildItem
Set-Alias grep Select-String

suggestions.label: Confirm before overwriting/removing
suggestions.description: Adds a confirmation prompt before Remove-Item deletes something, as a small safety net against typos.

suggestions.label: Bigger command history
suggestions.description: Keeps a lot more entries in your PSReadLine history so you can recall older commands with the up arrow.

suggestions.label: Useful command aliases
suggestions.description: Shorter names for the git subcommands you run constantly, plus a compact one-line graph log (`git lg`) for seeing branch history at a glance.
suggestions.snippet:
[alias]
	st = status
	co = checkout
	br = branch
	lg = log --oneline --graph --decorate --all

suggestions.label: Colored output and a sane pager
suggestions.description: Turns on colored status/diff/branch output and makes `less` not clear the screen after you quit, so output stays visible in your terminal scrollback.

suggestions.label: Default branch name and pull behavior
suggestions.description: New repos you `git init` start on `main` instead of `master`, and `git pull` merges by default instead of silently choosing rebase-or-merge based on config elsewhere.

suggestions.label: Rerere: remember resolved conflicts
suggestions.description: Git remembers how you resolved a merge conflict and automatically reapplies the same resolution if that exact conflict shows up again (common during long rebases).

suggestions.label: Auto-prune deleted remote branches
suggestions.description: Every `git fetch` also removes local references to branches that were deleted on the remote, so `git branch -a` stops showing stale entries.

suggestions.label: OS cruft
suggestions.description: The junk files macOS and Windows silently create inside every folder — safe to ignore everywhere, in every repo.

suggestions.label: Editor cruft
suggestions.description: Local editor/IDE settings and swap files that are specific to your machine and shouldn't be committed to any repo.

suggestions.label: Environment files
suggestions.description: Keeps your local secrets and environment overrides (API keys, local URLs) out of every repo by default, so you don't have to remember to add them per-project.

suggestions.label: Conventional Commits reminder
suggestions.description: A comment-only cheat sheet that shows up in every commit editor as a reminder of the type(scope): summary format, without forcing any particular style.
suggestions.snippet:
# type(scope): short summary
#
# feat / fix / docs / refactor / test / chore
#
# Why, not just what.

suggestions.label: Keep connections alive
suggestions.description: Sends a keepalive signal every 60 seconds so SSH sessions don't get silently dropped by NAT routers or firewalls during idle periods.

suggestions.label: Reuse connections (multiplexing)
suggestions.description: Reuses one already-open SSH connection for subsequent connections to the same host, making repeat `ssh`/`git` operations to the same server near-instant.

suggestions.label: Prefer identity files over agent forwarding
suggestions.description: Tells SSH to try your specific key files before asking an SSH agent, which can speed up auth when you have many keys loaded.

suggestions.label: Save exact versions
suggestions.description: New dependencies get pinned to an exact version (e.g. 1.2.3) instead of a caret range (^1.2.3), for more reproducible installs.

suggestions.label: Faster installs
suggestions.description: Prefers your local package cache over hitting the network, and skips the funding/audit messages that print on every install.

suggestions.label: Consistent engine checks
suggestions.description: Fails an install if your Node/npm version doesn't satisfy a package's declared `engines` field, catching version mismatches early instead of hitting a confusing runtime error.

suggestions.label: Mouse support
suggestions.description: Lets you click to switch panes, drag to resize them, and scroll with the mouse wheel — no keyboard-only navigation required.

suggestions.label: Vi-style copy mode
suggestions.description: Navigate and select text in tmux's copy mode using vi keybindings (h/j/k/l, v to select) instead of emacs-style ones.

suggestions.label: Reload config with prefix + r
suggestions.description: Lets you apply changes to this file immediately with a keybinding, instead of restarting your whole tmux server.

suggestions.label: Start windows and panes at 1
suggestions.description: Numbers windows/panes starting at 1 instead of 0, matching where they sit on your keyboard's number row.

suggestions.label: Sane editing defaults
suggestions.description: Shows line numbers, uses 2-space soft tabs instead of literal tab characters, and turns on syntax highlighting.
suggestions.snippet:
set number
set expandtab
set shiftwidth=2
set tabstop=2
syntax on

suggestions.label: Better search
suggestions.description: Search ignores case by default but becomes case-sensitive the moment you type an uppercase letter, and highlights matches as you type.
suggestions.snippet:
set ignorecase
set smartcase
set incsearch
set hlsearch

suggestions.label: Persistent undo
suggestions.description: Keeps your undo history even after closing and reopening a file, so you can undo changes from a previous editing session.

suggestions.label: Markdown: keep trailing whitespace (line breaks)
suggestions.description: Markdown uses two trailing spaces to mean "line break" — this stops editors from stripping them as if they were accidental whitespace.

suggestions.label: Makefiles require tabs
suggestions.description: Make syntax requires actual tab characters for indentation, not spaces — this section keeps EditorConfig from "fixing" that into spaces and breaking the Makefile.

suggestions.label: YAML: 2-space indentation
suggestions.description: YAML is indentation-sensitive; this pins YAML files to 2-space indents regardless of your other language settings.

suggestions.label: Smart case and hidden files
suggestions.description: Searches ignore case unless you type an uppercase letter, and also search dotfiles/hidden files that rg skips by default.

suggestions.label: Always ignore common build/VCS dirs
suggestions.description: Permanently excludes .git and node_modules from every search, even in projects without their own .gitignore rule for it.

suggestions.label: Show 2 lines of context around matches
suggestions.description: Prints a couple of surrounding lines around every match by default, giving you more context without passing -C each time.

suggestions.label: Common CLI tools
suggestions.description: A ripgrep + fzf + bat starter set — fast search, fuzzy finding, and a nicer `cat` with syntax highlighting.

suggestions.label: Git tooling
suggestions.description: GitHub's official CLI (`gh`) plus a diff-highlighting pager (`git-delta`) for much more readable `git diff` output.

suggestions.label: Format on save
suggestions.description: Automatically formats your code with the active formatter every time you save a file.

suggestions.label: Trim trailing whitespace and add a final newline
suggestions.description: Cleans up trailing whitespace and makes sure every file ends with a newline on save — what most linters expect anyway.

suggestions.label: Hide common noise from the file explorer
suggestions.description: Hides OS cruft and dependency folders from the file explorer sidebar so it stays focused on your actual code.

suggestions.label: Auto save on focus change
suggestions.description: Saves a file automatically the moment you switch away from its editor tab, so unsaved changes rarely pile up.

suggestions.label: Format on paste too
suggestions.description: Also reformats code you paste in, not just what you type — handy when pasting snippets from elsewhere.

suggestions.label: Keep the enclosing function/class visible while scrolling
suggestions.description: Pins the current function or class signature to the top of the editor as you scroll through a long file.

suggestions.label: Copy on select
suggestions.description: Selecting text in the terminal immediately copies it to your clipboard — no need to press Ctrl+C.

suggestions.label: Confirm before closing multiple tabs
suggestions.description: Adds a confirmation prompt when closing the window with more than one tab open, so a stray click can't lose a whole session.

suggestions.label: Launch on login
suggestions.description: Starts Windows Terminal automatically when you log in.

suggestions.label: Line numbers and no startup screen
suggestions.description: Shows line numbers in every buffer and skips straight past Emacs's splash screen into your last file or scratch buffer.

suggestions.label: Backups out of the way
suggestions.description: Moves Emacs's automatic backup~ files into a dedicated folder instead of scattering them next to every file you edit.

suggestions.label: Disable the toolbar and menu bar
suggestions.description: Frees up screen space by hiding the graphical toolbar and menu bar, common on a keyboard-driven Emacs setup.
